title: Distance approvals
hint: Daily reports where a vehicle's distance exceeds the site's default. Tap one to check, then approve or reject.
empty: No distance requests waiting for approval.
kmNote: Approving sets this report's distance to the requested value and includes it in fuel costs (currently counted at the default).
none: This report has no distance requests.
mine: You can't approve requests on your own report. Ask another approver.
rejectHint: If rejected, the distance stays at the default {km}km.

err.APPROVE_FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to approve.
err.SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN: You can't approve requests on your own report. Ask another approver.
err.conflict: The report was edited meanwhile. It has been reloaded — please check again.
err.other: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
